verdict.rationale: Undermind's own docs say users can "Collaborate on shared workspaces" and manage team members, and reports and syntheses are stored in the workspace, so collaborators can plausibly view and build on shared research. However, the sharing feature appears only as a one-line marketing mention with no documented mechanics. Missing for 10: per-report or per-session share links, view vs. edit permission controls, documentation of how collaborators build on a shared report, and independent or hands-on corroboration of sharing.

support.subject: As an analyst, I can share a research session or report with collaborators who can view or build on it

citations.quote: Creates and edits Markdown notes, syntheses, and reports in the workspace.
